subject: Demo deck v1 review comments (please add by Wed) + backup screenshots requests
body:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 10, 2025 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Demo deck v1 review comments (please add by Wed) + backup screenshots requests
Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Deck_v1_2025-11-10.pptx

Team — attached is Demo Deck v1 with my inline notes + a few open questions.

Top requests before we bless this for the pilot group:

1) Messaging / story arc tweaks
- Slide 2 headline: we keep vacillating between “Unified inference” vs “Production economics.” My vote: lead with production economics (latency + cost + reliability) and then land unified deployment as the “how it’s delivered.”
- Slide 5 (model catalog): we should NOT look like we’re selling “access to models.” We’re selling serving outcomes. Suggest we rewrite speaker notes to: “choose the right model per workload + pin versions + predictable rollouts.”
- Anywhere we say “Optimize” as a product name: can we treat it as a capability in the talk track? Customers have been asking if it’s an extra SKU.

2) Live demo transitions
- Need one clean slide that sets up: chat streaming → structured output/tool calling → economics toggles → reliability/fallback → console observability.
- Please add explicit handoff cues (AE vs SE) in speaker notes (bold “AE:” / “SE:”).

3) Backup mode assets
We need 6–8 “if live breaks” screenshots (annotated) in appendix:
- Console cost breakdown by route/model (token-level view)
- Rollouts view (canary / A-B)
- Error analysis / traces
- Audit logs (safe redaction; internal-only)
- Dedicated-style quota/capacity controls page
- Private/VPC architecture (we can use the existing diagram, but needs Redwood branding)

Can we please get placeholders by Wed EOD so design can start polishing? Markus — can you confirm which Console screens are stable enough to screenshot right now?

Drive folder (working): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rw-demo-deck-v1-working

Thanks,
Soojin

—
Soojin Lee
Product Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference


From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 10, 2025 at 9:41 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo deck v1 review comments (please add by Wed) + backup screenshots requests

+1 to leading with production economics.

Two field notes from last week:
- Execs will ask “why not just use X API?” early. We need a crisp single-slide answer that doesn’t sound like a benchmark fight. (Reliability + predictable unit costs + deployment flexibility.)
- Please remove/soften any absolute latency numbers unless we have the approved caveats on-screen. We’ve had people screenshot slides.

Also can we create a “20-min exec cut” slide map? AEs keep asking what to skip.

Steph


From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 10, 2025 at 10:06 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo deck v1 review comments (please add by Wed) + backup screenshots requests

Agree on repositioning “Optimize.” I’ll update copy so it reads as “cost/perf controls” vs a named module.

Re: “why not just use X API?” slide — propose:
- “It works in dev” (simple API)
- “It breaks in prod” (cost spikes, noisy neighbor, rollout surprises)
- “Redwood in prod” (pin + roll out safely + route/fallback + observability)

On backup screenshots:
- I opened DES-611 (screenshots + annotations) and DES-618 (visual refresh). If we can get raw captures by Wed, design can annotate Thurs/Fri.

Soojin — can you point me to the exact 6–8 screens you want in priority order? (If we ask for 12 we’ll get none.)

Camila


From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 10, 2025 at 11:18 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo deck v1 review comments (please add by Wed) + backup screenshots requests
Attachments: Slide_18_Console_CostBreakdown_mock.png, Slide_22_RolloutsView_placeholder.png

Confirmed: the following Console views are safe/stable to screenshot as of today (demo tenant is seeded):
- Usage → Cost & latency breakdown by route/model (token-level drilldown works)
- Observability → Errors (top error codes + sample traces)
- Deployments → Rollouts (canary view is stable; A/B is “mostly ok” but depends on seeded traffic job)

Not stable / avoid:
- New “Optimize recommendations” panel (copy/layout still moving)
- Empty state flows (we fixed one but it still looks weird if time range isn’t set)

I can get real screenshots from the demo tenant by tomorrow morning.

Re: “Audit logs” — we can show the screen but we need to be careful about what it contains (usernames, IPs). I suggest we use a staged screenshot with heavy redaction or keep it internal-only.

Markus


From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 10, 2025 at 1:02 PM PST
Subject: Re: Demo deck v1 review comments (please add by Wed) + backup screenshots requests

From the AE seat — two specific slide-level comments:

- Current slide order has “Private/VPC” too early. Prospects derail into security review mode before they’ve seen the product value. I’d push Private to appendix and keep 1–2 bullets in main flow (“same API across hosted/dedicated/private”).

- The tool-calling example needs to feel like a real workflow. “Weather API” reads like a hackathon demo. Can we swap to something like “create a support ticket + summarize logs” (even if it’s synthetic)?

Also: +1 on an exec cut (20 minutes). I’d love a version that is literally “slides 1, 3, 6, live demo, 14, 15, appendix.”

Avery


From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 10, 2025 at 2:27 PM PST
Subject: Re: Demo deck v1 review comments (please add by Wed) + backup screenshots requests

+1 on moving Private/VPC later.

One more nit: the “Dedicated” language is confusing on Slide 9 — it reads like “just buy GPUs from us.” We need to hammer “predictable throughput + isolation + autoscaling policies + SLA.”

If we can add a single diagram of “hosted vs dedicated vs private” with the same API surface across all, that would help.

Hannah


From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 10, 2025 at 4:47 PM PST
Subject: Re: Demo deck v1 review comments (please add by Wed) + backup screenshots requests

Super helpful — thank you all.

Camila, priority order for backup screenshots (6):
1) Cost breakdown by route/model (token-level)
2) Rollouts (canary)
3) Error analysis (with trace snippet)
4) Dedicated-style quotas/capacity controls (even if it’s a “demo” config page)
5) Private/VPC architecture diagram (branded)
6) Audit logs (INTERNAL-ONLY version w/ redaction)

Markus — please drop the real captures into the Drive folder under /Appendix/Screenshots by tomorrow 11am PT.

Steph/Avery/Hannah — I’ll add a “20-min exec cut” slide map in speaker notes + a small footer label on the slide thumbnails (e.g., “Exec Core” vs “Deep Dive”).

Also aligned: we’ll remove the hacky tool-calling example and swap to “create a support ticket + summarize incident notes” (fully synthetic). I’ll coordinate w/ DevEx separately so the live demo matches.

Next checkpoint: quick 20-min review Wed 3pm PT (calendar to follow).

Soojin
